name: Bridgmanite
description: Mg-Fe-Al orthorhombic silicate perovskites, including pure endmembers, named experimental samples, hydrous and vacancy-bearing variants, and explicitly hypothetical Al2O3 perovskite model endpoints. The formula is descriptive; exact composition and phase remain on each material. Other perovskite chemistries are excluded.

name: Garnet
description: Silicate garnet compositions, currently pyrope, almandine and majorite. Cubic and tetragonal structures and exact formula normalization remain distinct on each material. Other MgSiO3 structures are excluded.

name: Magnesite
description: MgCO3 magnesite and documented Fe/Mn-substituted magnesite samples. Exact analytical compositions remain on their cards. Dolomite and calcium carbonates are excluded.

name: Mg–Fe monoxide
description: Solid Mg-Fe monoxides, including MgO and FeO endmembers, ferropericlase, magnesiowustite, minor-substituted and cation-deficient samples. B1, distorted B1, B2 and B8 structures remain distinct material entries. Liquids and higher iron oxides are excluded.

name: NaAlSiO4 calcium-ferrite type
description: NaAlSiO4 calcium-ferrite-type material and its measured Fe-free and Fe-bearing composition variants, including reported non-stoichiometry. Other calcium-ferrite-type chemistries and the NAL structure are excluded.

name: Olivine
description: Mg-Fe olivine compositions, currently the forsterite and fayalite endmembers. Wadsleyite, ringwoodite and other orthosilicate structures are excluded.

name: Phase D
description: Composition variants documented as phase D: Mg-rich, Al-bearing, and Fe-bearing aluminous samples. Reported symmetry, cation ordering, hydrogen content and analytical uncertainty remain on each material. Other named dense hydrous phases are excluded.

name: Post-perovskite
description: Mg-Fe-Al CaIrO3-type Cmcm silicate post-perovskites, including pure endmembers, hydrous and vacancy-bearing variants, and the explicitly hypothetical Al2O3 model endpoint. CaIrO3 and germanate analogues and Cmmm post-perovskite-II are excluded.
